title: Claim and work in hand
description: Who holds a task and what the holder recorded about the work in hand. A claim makes the task in_progress and names its holder; only one claim on a task succeeds. Each work detail replaces the one before it, and releasing or closing the task clears them; history keeps every value. Section 3.3 of the protocol.

workDetails.description: Only the details the holder recorded. A server keeps these six; a reader ignores any other.

session.description: A link to, or the id of, the agent session doing the work.

next.description: The next step, in one line.

assignee.description: The holder, or null while nobody holds the task.

for.description: The helper agent the holder works through, as the holder named it; null when it named none. The holder still holds the task.

lastActivityAt.description: When the holder last changed or commented on the task. Shown only: it never releases a claim.
